Benchmark + BAGEL-SFT release

Teach models to see the room from every angle.

MindView tests whether a model can read several views, follow a spatial instruction, and render the right target view of an indoor scene.

01 / The benchmark

A controlled test of observation → instruction → view.

Every case starts with RGB observations of the same indoor scene and a spatial query. The generator must infer the requested camera change while target images, depth, and numerical camera parameters stay hidden.

01Observe

Six context images

Views from ScanNet, ScanNet++, and ARKitScenes establish the room and its geometry.

02Interpret
?

“Move the view behind the chair and face the window.”

One spatial query

Language specifies translation, rotation, composition, or an object-centered relation.

03Render
512 × 512 RGB

One target view

The output is scored against fixed references with image, semantic, spatial, and geometric checks.

02 / The task map

Seven ways to ask
where the camera should go.

MindView separates geometric movement from semantic intent, then combines both in multi-cue instructions.

01GEOMETRY

Translation

Move to a requested position while preserving the scene.

↗
02GEOMETRY

Rotation

Turn the viewpoint toward a new direction.

↗
03GEOMETRY

Composition

Change position and orientation together.

↗
04SEMANTICS

Relational grounding

Locate an object through relations to its surroundings.

↗
05SEMANTICS

Target-facing reorientation

Reorient the camera toward a named target.

↗
06SEMANTICS

Object-centric repositioning

Move around an object while keeping its role in view.

↗
07SEMANTICS + GEOMETRY

Multi-cue viewpoint inference

Resolve several spatial cues in one instruction, combining scene geometry and semantic anchors.

↗

03 / The evaluation stack

One image.
Six lenses.

MindView treats a target view as a structured prediction. The report builder keeps the primary metrics separate so a high visual score cannot hide a geometric or semantic miss.

Read the evaluation guide ↗
Metric familyWhat it checksRole
DINO-Iimage-level visual alignmentPRIMARY
Semanticobject and instruction consistencyPRIMARY
Spatialviewpoint and scene arrangementPRIMARY
Qualityperceptual image qualityPRIMARY
VGGT-RScorerelative geometric structurePRIMARY
VGGT-TScoretranslation consistencyPRIMARY
CLIP-I is retained as an auxiliary comparison.

04 / The release

From benchmark
to a reproducible run.

The public release keeps the data, evaluation chain, and BAGEL supervised fine-tuning recipe together, with pinned snapshots and workflow guides for each stage.
